name: Landing Screen & Header Banner
user_action: Launch shell without arguments ($ bun start)
state_transition: Mounts Root -> renders logo banner, model indicator, cwd, and shortcut hints
rendered_ui: ASCII/Unicode Logo, model name badge, effort badge, path banner
rationale: Core presentation shell; pure Ink/React rendering with zero backend coupling.
seam_impact: None. Runs entirely within Claude frontend.

name: First-Run Onboarding Dialog
user_action: First launch when config.hasCompletedOnboarding is false
state_transition: showSetupScreens() -> renders Onboarding wizard
rendered_ui: Theme selection picker, welcome text, confirmation button
rationale: User preferences & theme setup; local UI state.

name: Workspace Trust Boundary Modal
user_action: Launch in untrusted working directory
state_transition: Checks checkHasTrustDialogAccepted() -> renders security confirmation
rendered_ui: Directory trust warning modal with Accept / Reject keys
rationale: Essential security boundary for filesystem tool access.

name: Prompt Input Single-line Composer
user_action: Type alphanumeric characters in PromptInput
state_transition: onChange event -> updates text buffer and cursor index
rendered_ui: Themed input box with active cursor rendering
rationale: Pure client presentation component managing Ink keystroke stream.

name: Multiline Composer & Linebreak Handling
user_action: Press Shift+Enter or Ctrl+J to insert newline
state_transition: Splits buffer on newline, recomputes viewport line wrapping and cursor position
rendered_ui: Expanding multi-row text box with line continuation markers
rationale: Essential terminal composer UX.

name: Cursor Navigation & Word Jumps
user_action: Press Left/Right/Home/End, Alt+Left/Right, Ctrl+A/E
state_transition: Calculates Unicode grapheme boundaries and word regex offsets
rendered_ui: Cursor indicator shifted to target column/row
rationale: Pure terminal interaction math.

name: Prompt History Up/Down Recall
user_action: Press Up / Down arrow in empty or top line of composer
state_transition: Fetches prompt from history ring buffer
rendered_ui: Populates composer with historical prompt string
rationale: Local developer convenience feature.

name: Slash Command Autocomplete Palette
user_action: Type / at beginning of prompt line
state_transition: Opens floating popup modal filtering commands list
rendered_ui: Bordered popup box listing /compact, /cost, /help, /model, /review, etc.
rationale: Pure client command selector.

name: Client-Side Slash Command Handler
user_action: Execute client command (e.g. /clear, /theme, /effort)
state_transition: REPL.onSubmit intercept matches command.type === local
state_mutation: Mutates active theme or effort state in AppState
rendered_ui: System message banner or updated UI theme tokens
rationale: Local UI preferences and terminal layout toggles.

name: Authentication Command (/login, /logout)
user_action: User runs /login or /logout
state_transition: Launches OAuth web flow / token prompt
state_mutation: Updates session auth token in secure storage
rendered_ui: Login prompt dialog with browser URL and token input
rationale: Anthropic OAuth replaced with Brain authentication & daemon pairing.
seam_impact: Seam 4: Replaced by Brain auth token / credentials management.

name: Prompt Submission & Turn Dispatch
user_action: Press Enter with non-empty input in PromptInput
state_transition: Appends UserMessage to state -> locks queryGuard -> triggers onQuery
rendered_ui: User message box added to Messages list; spinner starts requesting
rationale: Standard UI submission flow; drives message list state.

name: Incremental Text Streaming & Typewriter Queue
user_action: Model streams response chunks
state_transition: StreamEvent(content_block_delta) -> handleMessageFromStream
rendered_ui: Live markdown token stream rendered with typing animation
rationale: Backend text generation replaced by Brain; frontend rendering completely preserved.

name: Turn Completion & Final Message Materialization
user_action: Model generation ends (message_stop)
state_transition: Yields AssistantMessage -> setMessages -> clears streamingText
rendered_ui: Solidified AssistantMessage block in VirtualMessageList; prompt restored
rationale: Assistant message generated by Brain model turn.

name: Turn Interruption & Stream Cancellation
user_action: Press Ctrl+C or submit new prompt while turn is streaming
state_transition: abortController.abort() -> signals AbortSignal.aborted = true
backend: Brain Backend Stream Drop / Cancellation Token
rendered_ui: Inline [Interrupted by user] note; prompt input re-enabled
rationale: AbortSignal listener mapped to Brain stream cancellation.
seam_impact: Seam: QueryDeps.callModel signal listener drops Brain subscription.

name: Thinking / Extended Reasoning Stream
user_action: Model streams reasoning tokens prior to text
state_transition: StreamEvent(content_block_start: thinking) -> setStreamMode(thinking)
rendered_ui: Collapsible Thinking... block with duration stopwatch
rationale: Backend reasoning generated by Brain reasoning models; frontend UI preserved.
seam_impact: Seam: QueryDeps.callModel yields thinking_delta stream events.

name: Streaming Tool Invocation Header
user_action: Model emits tool_use content block
state_transition: content_block_start(type: tool_use) -> setStreamMode(tool-input)
rendered_ui: Tool use card mounted (e.g. Bash(command: ...)) with spinner
rationale: Brain generates tool_use blocks; Claude streams & renders the invocation.

name: Interactive Tool Permission Confirmation
user_action: Tool requires confirmation (e.g. mutating bash command)
state_transition: StreamingToolExecutor prompts user for permission approval
rendered_ui: Bordered permission modal: Allow command: git commit? [Y/n/always]
rationale: Claude owns permission checks and UI dialogs; ensures zero security regression.
seam_impact: None. Executed natively by Claude queryLoop.

name: Native Tool Execution (Bash, Edit, Read, Glob, Grep)
user_action: Approved tool runs on host system
state_transition: Executes Tool.call(input) -> produces ToolResultBlock
rendered_ui: Tool output box rendered (syntax-highlighted code / diff / command stdout)
rationale: Claude executes tools locally; preserves complete tool ecosystem.
seam_impact: Seam: Subsequent callModel receives paired tool_use + tool_result.

name: Session Resume & Conversation Chooser
user_action: Launch with /resume or claude --resume
state_transition: Lists saved sessions from disk -> loads selected transcript
rendered_ui: Interactive session selector showing title, time, and preview
rationale: Claude session picker adapted to load Brain graph-backed sessions.
seam_impact: Seam: Session history provider mapped to Brain session storage.

name: Context Compaction & Memory Pruning
user_action: Conversation token count exceeds model context window
state_transition: autoCompactIfNeeded() summarizes older messages and inserts boundary
rendered_ui: Horizontal compact boundary divider with summarized context badge
rationale: Claude manages compaction boundaries; summarization model call uses Brain.
seam_impact: Seam: QueryDeps.autocompact / microcompact mapped to Brain summarizer.

name: Theme Selection & Terminal Adaptation
user_action: User runs /theme or switches terminal dark/light mode
state_transition: Mutates active ThemeContext -> triggers repaint with semantic colors
rendered_ui: Full UI re-colored (dark, light, daltonized, high-contrast)
rationale: Core TUI design system and terminal color token manager.

name: Responsive SIGWINCH Terminal Resizing
user_action: User resizes terminal window
state_transition: SIGWINCH event -> recalculates columns/rows -> re-flows Yoga flexbox
rendered_ui: Smooth non-flickering reflow of message cards and input boxes
rationale: Pure Ink terminal layout engine.
